title: 全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师_柠蓝浅夏_第4章 操作失误了
content_zh:
对方的信息，只有一串数字编号，连个头像都没有。

在这诡异的世界里，陌生人带来的危险，往往比黑夜里的怪物更令人胆寒。

片刻的迟疑后，他还是点了通过申请。

【编号36454160：大佬救命！那瓶花酿能不能先借我顶一顶？我理智马上清零，周围已经全黑了，我发誓明天凑够幸存点绝对双倍还你！】

许默心生嗤笑。

这种虚无缥缈他实在太熟悉了。

冰冷的现实世界里，他曾经为了给重病的亲人凑救命钱，敲开过一扇扇亲戚的门，那时他听过的冷嘲热讽、看过的刻薄嘴脸，比这三言两语要残酷一百倍。

在生死边缘谈信用，简直是天大的笑话。

【许默：不借。】

干脆利落的两个字发过去，没有丝毫商量的余地。

本以为对方会知难而退，或者干脆破口大骂，没想到聊天界面很快又闪烁起来。

【编号36454160：别啊大佬！求求你别关聊天框！那以物换物行不行？我拿全部家当跟你换！】

许默放在关闭按钮上的手指猛地悬停。

频道私聊是需要消耗理智值的。

对方明知理智即将枯竭，却还要顶着彻底崩溃的风险疯狂发消息，这分明是垂死挣扎。

既然对方穷途末路，连全部家当都愿意送了，看看也无妨。

【许默：截图发来看看。】

叮叮叮几声轻响，几张色彩暗淡的图片接连弹了出来。

枯草、残缺的树杈、几块灰扑扑的石头。

一堆毫无价值的破烂。

许默眉头紧紧拧在一起，刚准备抬手切断通讯，视线却忽然凝固在最后一张图片的角落。

在一堆废料边缘，挨着半个生锈的破铁罐和装水的容器旁，赫然装着一坨黏稠透亮的半流淌状物体，外面还严严实实裹着几片宽大的翠绿叶子。

蜂蜜？

许默瞳孔骤然收缩。

【许默：你有蜂蜜？交易行里怎么从来没见你挂过？】

【编号36454160：我挂了啊！标价20幸存点，挂了一整个下午都没人看一眼！现在大家连一口干净水都喝不上，谁有闲心去买这种甜腻腻的累赘玩意儿！大佬你要是能看上，我全给你打包发过去！】

许默深吸一口气，强行压下心头的狂喜。

普通人拿蜂蜜当累赘，可他不一样。

他的天赋是【酿酒师】。

有了蜂蜜，就有机会酿出传说中的蜂蜜酒，这种高热量且极难腐败的东西，在生存游戏里绝对是无价之宝。

没有半点犹豫，他直接调出交易面板。

【许默：五份蜂蜜，连带你用来装蜂蜜的那个叶子包一起交易过来，换一份花酿。】

【编号36454160：换换换！大佬你简直是我的再生父母！！】

光芒一闪，交易瞬间完成。

沉甸甸的包凭空出现，而放入界面的花酿，也随之消失不见。

许默根本顾不上理会对方千恩万谢的连环信息，直接反手关闭了聊天界面。

他迫不及待地点开【制作】中的【酿酒】选项。

五份黏稠的蜂蜜被拖入填充框。

紧接着放入十份水。

没反应。

最下方的【制作】图标依旧像死灰一样黯淡无光。

许默咬紧后槽牙，飞速调整比例。

三份蜂蜜配五份水，不行。

一份配一份，还是不行。

难道这个破游戏的世界规则里，根本不存在蜂蜜酒这种产物？

这样他不就真的白白浪费了一瓶花酿？

对方还说这破蜂蜜卖不出去呢！自己不是成了大冤种了吗？

烦躁的情绪如同野草般在心头疯长，手指在虚空中猛地乱划。

完蛋！

操作失误了。

一朵原本静静躺在负重栏里的鲜花，被他不小心滑进了配方框。

水、蜂蜜、鲜花，三种截然不同的材料在填充框内诡异地并列在一起。

原本灰扑扑的【制作】图标，骤然迸发出耀眼的金色光芒！

许默呼吸一滞，毫不犹豫地重重点击下去。

【获得“蜂蜜花酿”X1】

一瓶泛着琥珀色光泽的浓稠液体出现在掌心，哪怕隔着虚无的面板，似乎都能闻到那种沁人心脾的甜香。

他急不可耐地瞪大眼睛，看着弹出的属性说明。

【蜂蜜花酿】

【效果：恢复理智30点，体力10点，干渴30点。】

【附加状态：获得8小时“触角”效果，期间可主动消耗10点理智，与蜂类生物进行沟通。】

许默整个人僵在原地。

恢复数值慷慨得离谱，简直堪称绝世神药。

可最后那一行极其刺眼的附加状态，却硬生生把他的激动砸得粉碎。

他缓缓转过头，望向四周浓雾弥漫、死寂荒芜的贫瘠荒原。

阴冷的寒风穿过枯死的树干，发出令人毛骨悚然的凄厉呜咽，干裂的土地上连一根新鲜的绿草都找不出来。

在这个连鸟都会拉完屎就跑的鬼地方，去哪找一只蜜蜂来沟通？！

【负重警告：当前负重已达上限，体力流失速度增加300%，饱腹值加速下降！】

许默沉着脸，将蜂蜜和蜂蜜花酿强行塞进粗糙的背包里。

肩带瞬间勒进皮肉，双腿像是灌了铅一样沉重。

胃部紧接着传来一阵火烧般的抽痛。

饱腹值正在以肉眼可见的速度坠向冰点。

许默眼底闪过狠厉，反手从物品栏里抓出一把表面已经泛起灰斑的蓝蘑菇。

【不新鲜的蓝蘑菇：食用后恢复微量饱腹，有极小概率引发肠胃不适。】

管不了那么多了。

他仰起脖子，把这些带着腐败土腥味的菌块粗暴地塞进嘴里，连嚼都没怎么嚼，硬生生咽进肚子里。

恶心的土腥味在口腔里炸开，饱腹值的红色警报这踩堪堪停住，但负重还是存在。

必须减重。

许默的目光落在掌心那杯散发着琥珀色光晕的【蜂蜜花酿】上。

不管这玩意儿在这鸟不拉屎的荒原能引来什么蜂，先保住命才是核心规则！

仰起头，一饮而尽。

醇厚的甜香化作暖流，四肢百骸瞬间涌起一股力量感，干枯的理智与体力条疯狂暴涨。

负重警告随之解除。

许默长长吐出一口浊气，紧绷的神经还未彻底放松，忽然间。

“来呀……”

“好香……好想靠近……”

“王……你是我的王……”

“我的！我的！我的！看着我！”

content_en:
The other party's information only contained a series of numbers, not even an avatar.

In this weird world, the dangers brought by strangers are often more frightening than monsters in the night.

After a moment's hesitation, he clicked to approve the application.

[Number 36454160: Boss, help!Can you lend me that bottle of flower wine first?My sanity was cleared immediately, and everything around me was completely dark. I swear I will repay you twice as much as I can if I gather enough survival points tomorrow!】

Xu Mo sneered.

This kind of emptiness was all too familiar to him.

In the cold real world, he once knocked on the doors of relatives in order to collect life-saving money for his seriously ill relatives. The cynicism he heard and the mean faces he saw at that time were a hundred times crueler than these few words.

Talking about credit on the edge of life and death is simply a big joke.

[Xu Mo: I won’t borrow it.】

Two words were sent out crisply, leaving no room for negotiation.

I thought that the other party would give up or simply curse, but I didn't expect that the chat interface would flash again soon.

[Number 36454160: Stop it, boss!Please don't close the chat box!Is it okay to exchange things for things?I'll give you all my belongings in exchange!】

Xu Mo's finger on the close button suddenly hovered.

Channel private chats require sanity points.

The other party knows that his sanity is about to run out, yet he still sends messages frantically at the risk of complete collapse. This is clearly a desperate struggle.

Since the other party is at the end of his rope and is willing to give away all his belongings, it doesn't hurt to take a look.

[Xu Mo: Send me a screenshot.】

There were a few soft ding-ding-ding sounds, and several dimly colored pictures popped up one after another.

Withered grass, broken tree branches, and a few gray stones.

A worthless pile of junk.

Xu Mo frowned tightly and was about to raise his hand to cut off the communication, but his eyes suddenly froze at the corner of the last picture.

At the edge of a pile of scraps, next to half a rusty tin can and a water container, there was a thick and translucent semi-liquid object, tightly wrapped with a few broad green leaves.

Honey?

Xu Mo's pupils suddenly shrank.

[Xu Mo: Do ​​you have honey?Why have I never seen you fail in the trading house?】

[Number 36454160: I died!The price was listed at 20 survival points, but no one even looked at it the whole afternoon!Nowadays, everyone can’t even drink a sip of clean water. Who has the time to buy such sweet and cumbersome stuff?Boss, if you like it, I will package it all and send it to you!】

Xu Mo took a deep breath and suppressed the ecstasy in his heart.

Ordinary people regard honey as a burden, but he is different.

His talent is [Winemaker].

With honey, you have the opportunity to brew the legendary mead. This high-calorie and extremely difficult to corrupt thing is absolutely priceless in survival games.

Without any hesitation, he directly called up the trading panel.

[Xu Mo: Five portions of honey, trade them together with the leaf bag you used to store the honey, and exchange them for a portion of flower brew.】

[No. 36454160: Change, change!Boss, you are simply my reborn parents!!】

With a flash of light, the transaction was completed instantly.

The heavy package appeared out of thin air, and the flower wine placed in the interface also disappeared.

Xu Mo ignored the other party's thank you messages and closed the chat interface directly.

He couldn't wait to open the [Brewing] option in [Production].

Five portions of sticky honey are dragged into the fill box.

Then add ten parts of water.

No response.

The [Production] icon at the bottom is still as dull as ashes.

Xu Mo clenched his molars and quickly adjusted the proportions.

Three parts honey to five parts water won't work.

One part for one part, but it still doesn't work.

Could it be that in this game-breaking world, there is no such thing as mead?

Didn't he really waste a bottle of flower brew in this way?

The other party also said that the honey cannot be sold!Didn’t I become a big injustice?

The irritable emotions are growing like weeds in my heart, and my fingers are scratching wildly in the void.

Done!

The operation went wrong.

A flower that was lying quietly in the weight-bearing column accidentally slipped into the formula box.

Water, honey, flowers, three distinct materials are eerily juxtaposed within the filled frame.

The originally gray [Production] icon suddenly burst into dazzling golden light!

Xu Mo's breath froze and he clicked hard without hesitation.

[Get "Honey Flower Brewing" X1]

A bottle of thick liquid with an amber luster appeared in the palm of my hand. Even through the empty panel, I could smell the refreshing sweet fragrance.

He opened his eyes impatiently and looked at the attribute description that popped up.

【Honey flower brew】

[Effect: Restore 30 points of sanity, 10 points of physical strength, and 30 points of thirst.】

[Additional status: Gain the "tentacle" effect for 8 hours, during which you can actively consume 10 points of sanity to communicate with bee creatures.】

Xu Mo froze in place.

The recovery value is ridiculously generous, and it can be called a miracle medicine.

But the extremely dazzling additional status at the end crushed his excitement to pieces.

He slowly turned his head and looked around at the barren wasteland filled with thick fog, dead and desolate.

The cold wind passed through the dead tree trunks, making a blood-curdling scream. Not even a single piece of fresh green grass could be found on the dry and cracked land.

In this hellish place where even birds can run away after pooping, where can I find a bee to communicate with?!

[Weight-bearing warning: The current weight-bearing limit has been reached, the stamina loss rate increases by 300%, and the satiety value decreases at an accelerated rate!】

Xu Mo sullenly stuffed the honey and honey flower stuffing into his rough backpack.

The shoulder straps instantly cut into the flesh, and the legs felt as heavy as lead.

Then there was a burning pain in my stomach.

The satiety value is falling towards the freezing point at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Xu Mo's eyes flashed fiercely, and he grabbed a handful of blue mushrooms with gray spots on the surface from the inventory.

[Stale blue mushrooms: After eating, you will regain a small amount of satiety and may cause gastrointestinal discomfort.】

I can’t control that much anymore.

He raised his neck and roughly stuffed the fungi with the smell of putrid earth into his mouth. He didn't even chew much and swallowed them into his stomach.

The disgusting earthy smell exploded in my mouth, and the red alarm of fullness almost stopped, but the weight was still there.

Must lose weight.

Xu Mo's eyes fell on the cup of [Honey Flower Brewing] with amber halo in his palm.

No matter what kind of bees this thing attracts in this barren wasteland, the core rule is to save your life first!

He raised his head and drank it all in one gulp.

The mellow sweet fragrance turned into warmth, and a sense of power suddenly surged through all the limbs, and the dry sanity and physical strength soared crazily.

The weight warning was then lifted.

Xu Mo let out a long breath, and before his tense nerves could completely relax, suddenly.

"Come on..."

"It smells so good... I really want to be close..."

"King...you are my king..."

"Mine! Mine! Mine! Look at me!"
